about: Glories Basement, 2026-10-10 18:52-18:59 UTC: walking back from the food court to the entrance escalator with the Orient app (staging, commit 0f445cf), on a map built from one walk the other way. From the orchestrator's own trace in Cloud Logging (orient-orchestrator-staging, jsonPayload.mapId=glories-basement): each frame's nav-api localize answer (status, best, margin, top two candidates) and whether the orchestrator placed the user ('located at nX'), per session. Left out: frames it dropped as stale, and one localize call that failed on the network. Live, every placement asked nav-api for a route to n1 over observed edges: 76 calls, none found, and the app said 'Please hold still, I need a clearer view.'. routes: nav-api's answers from each placement, fetched the same evening with trust observed and any.

sessions.said: I want to go to the escalators at the entrance
Take me to the Entrance escalator

hops.instruction: Walk about 6 metres with shop fronts on your left, bearing left. The escalators hum just ahead on your left, by a big pillar.

steps.until: escalator hum

hops.instruction: With the escalators behind you, walk about 6 metres, shop fronts on your left, bearing right past a large potted plant. The Sprinter shop is ahead.

steps.until: smooth large floor tiles

hops.instruction: Walk about 3 metres back through the automatic glass doors. The floor turns to stone and the escalator is just ahead.

steps.until: metal grate across the floor at the escalator foot

hops.instruction: Turn so the glass doors are behind you and find the escalator foot. Hold the handrail and ride up about 5 metres, then step off onto the street plaza.

steps.until: moving rubber handrails on both sides
